item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 2 - 2026-08-10 01:53
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：49 分钟 (2420 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
The sense of touch has sometimes been described as weak too, but this view is probably mistaken. 触觉有时也被描述为很弱，但这种看法很可能是错误的。 touch: 触觉
described as: 被描述为
view: 观点，看法
mistaken: 错误的		 “has been described as” 是现在完成时被动语态，表示“一直被描述为”；“this view is probably mistaken” 中 mistaken 是形容词作表语，表示“错误的”。注意转折连词 but。
Trainers of captive dolphins and small whales often remark on their animals' responsiveness to being touched or rubbed, and both captive and freeranging cetacean individuals of all species (particularly adults and calves, or members of the same subgroup) appear to make frequent contact. 圈养海豚和小鲸鱼的训练师经常谈及它们的动物对被触摸或揉搓的反应性，而且所有物种的圈养和自由放养的鲸目动物个体（特别是成年和幼崽，或者同一亚群的成员）似乎会频繁接触。 captive: 圈养的
remark on: 谈及，评论
responsiveness: 反应性
touched or rubbed: 被触摸或揉搓
freeranging: 自由放养的
cetacean: 鲸目动物
calves: 幼崽
subgroup: 亚群
make contact: 进行接触		 “remark on” 为固定搭配，表示“评论/谈及”；“responsiveness to being touched” 中 to 是介词，后接动名词被动式 being touched； “both captive and freeranging” 并列作定语修饰 cetacean individuals； “appear to make contact” 表示“似乎进行接触”。
This contact may help to maintain order within a group, and stroking or touching are part of the courtship ritual in most species. 这种接触可能有助于维持群体内的秩序，而抚摸或触碰在大多数物种中是求偶仪式的一部分。 maintain: 维持
order: 秩序
stroking: 抚摸
courtship: 求偶
ritual: 仪式		 “help to maintain” 中 help 后可接带 to 或不带 to 的不定式； “be part of” 意为“是……的一部分”； “courtship ritual” 为固定搭配“求偶仪式”。
The area around the blowhole is also particularly sensitive and captive animals often object strongly to being touched there. 喷气孔周围的区域也特别敏感，圈养动物常常强烈反对被触摸那里。 blowhole: 喷气孔
sensitive: 敏感的
object to: 反对		 “object to” 中 to 为介词，后接动名词被动式 being touched； “particularly sensitive” 作表语，表示“尤其敏感”。
The sense of vision is developed to different degrees in different species. 视觉在不同物种中发展到了不同的程度。 vision: 视觉
degree: 程度		 “is developed to different degrees” 被动语态，表示“被发展到不同程度”，强调客观描述。
Baleen species studied at close quarters underwater - specifically a grey whale calf in captivity for a year, and free-ranging right whales and humpback whales studied and filmed off Argentina and Hawaii - have obviously tracked objects with vision underwater, and they can apparently see moderately well both in water and in air. 在水下近距离研究的须鲸物种——具体来说，一只被圈养了一年的灰鲸幼崽，以及在阿根廷和夏威夷附近研究并拍摄的自由放养的露脊鲸和座头鲸——显然在水下用视觉追踪物体，而且它们显然在水中和空气中都有中等的视力。 baleen: 鲸须
at close quarters: 近距离地
grey whale: 灰鲸
right whale: 露脊鲸
humpback whale: 座头鲸
tracked: 追踪
moderately: 中等地		 “studied at close quarters” 是过去分词短语作定语；破折号之间是具体举例； “have tracked” 为现在完成时； “see moderately well” 表示视力中等； “both in water and in air” 并列状语。
However, the position of the eyes so restricts the field of vision in baleen whales that they probably do not have stereoscopic vision. 然而，眼睛的位置如此限制须鲸的视野，以至于它们可能没有立体视觉。 restricts: 限制
field of vision: 视野
stereoscopic: 立体的		 “so... that...” 句型表示“如此……以至于……”； “restrict the field of vision” 搭配； “stereoscopic vision” 意为“立体视觉”。
On the other hand, the position of the eyes in most dolphins and porpoises suggests that they have stereoscopic vision forward and downward. 另一方面，大多数海豚和鼠海豚的眼睛位置表明它们有向前和向下的立体视觉。 porpoises: 鼠海豚
stereoscopic: 立体的
forward and downward: 向前和向下		 “On the other hand” 表示对比； “suggests that” 后接宾语从句； “forward and downward” 作后置定语修饰 vision。
Eye position in freshwater dolphins, which often swim on their side or upside down while feeding, suggests that what vision they have is stereoscopic forward and upward. 淡水海豚的眼睛位置——它们经常在进食时侧着身子或倒置游泳——表明它们所具有的视觉是向前和向上的立体视觉。 freshwater: 淡水
upside down: 颠倒
feeding: 进食		 “which often swim...” 是非限制性定语从句； “what vision they have” 是主语从句，相当于 the vision that they have； “on their side or upside down” 方式状语。
By comparison, the bottlenose dolphin has extremely keen vision in water. 相比之下，宽吻海豚在水中有极其敏锐的视觉。 bottlenose dolphin: 宽吻海豚
keen: 敏锐的		 “By comparison” 意为“相比之下”； “extremely keen vision” 表示“极其敏锐的视觉”。
Judging from the way it watches and tracks airborne flying fish, it can apparently see fairly well through the air-water interface as well. 从它观察和追踪空中飞鱼的方式来看，它显然也能透过空气-水的界面看得相当清楚。 judging from: 从……判断
airborne: 空中的
flying fish: 飞鱼
interface: 界面		 “Judging from...” 是垂悬分词作状语； “the way it watches” 方式状语从句； “see fairly well through the air-water interface” 动介搭配。
And although preliminary experimental evidence suggests that their in-air vision is poor, the accuracy with which dolphins leap high to take small fish out of a trainer's hand provides anecdotal evidence to the contrary. 而且，尽管初步的实验证据表明它们的空中视觉很差，但海豚高高跳起从训练员手中取走小鱼的准确性提供了相反的轶事证据。 preliminary: 初步的
experimental: 实验的
accuracy: 准确性
leap: 跳跃
anecdotal: 轶事的
to the contrary: 相反地		 “although” 引导让步状语从句； “the accuracy with which dolphins leap...” 是“介词+关系代词”引导的定语从句，先行词 accuracy； “provides anecdotal evidence to the contrary” 提供了相反的非正式证据。
Such variation can no doubt be explained with reference to the habitats in which individual species have developed. 这种差异无疑可以通过各个物种发展所处的栖息地来解释。 variation: 差异
no doubt: 无疑
with reference to: 根据，参考
habitats: 栖息地		 “can no doubt be explained” 被动语态； “with reference to” 意为“根据，参考”； “in which individual species have developed” 定语从句修饰 habitats。
For example, vision is obviously more useful to species inhabiting clear open waters than to those living in turbid rivers and flooded plains. 例如，视觉对于栖息在清澈开阔水域的物种显然比对于生活在浑浊河流和泛滥平原的物种更有用。 inhabiting: 栖息于
turbid: 浑浊的
flooded plains: 泛滥平原		 “more useful to... than to...” 比较结构； “species inhabiting...” 现在分词作定语； “those living in...” 中 those 指代 species。
The South American boutu and Chinese beiji, for instance, appear to have very limited vision, and the Indian susus are blind, their eyes reduced to slits that probably allow them to sense only the direction and intensity of light. 例如，南美洲的亚马逊河豚和中国的白鳍豚似乎视力非常有限，而印度河豚是盲的，它们的眼睛退化为狭缝，可能只能感知光的方向和强度。 boutu: 亚马逊河豚
beiji: 白鳍豚
susus: 印度河豚
blind: 盲的
slits: 狭缝
intensity: 强度		 “appear to have” 似乎有； “their eyes reduced to slits” 是独立主格结构，表示伴随状态； “that probably allow...” 定语从句修饰 slits； “sense the direction and intensity” 感知方向和强度。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 1 等多主题 - 2026-08-07 02:43
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：44 分钟 (2170 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
In answer to the final question about the importance of rainforest conservation, the majority of children simply said that we need rainforests to survive.在回答关于雨林保护重要性的最后一个问题时，大多数孩子仅表示我们需要雨林才能生存。in answer to：作为对……的回答
conservation：保护
the majority of：大多数
simply：仅仅，简单地
survive：生存		“in answer to” 为固定短语，表示“作为对……的回答”；“the majority of + 复数名词” 作主语时，谓语可用单数或复数，此句用复数 said；“simply” 强调只说了一件事。
Only a few of the pupils (6%) mentioned that rainforest destruction may contribute to global warming.只有少数学生（6%）提到雨林破坏可能会导致全球变暖。a few of：几个，少数
pupils：学生
mentioned：提到
destruction：破坏
contribute to：促成，导致
global warming：全球变暖		“Only a few of...” 表示数量很少；“contribute to” 意为“促成，是……的原因之一”，后接名词或动名词。
This is surprising considering the high level of media coverage on this issue.考虑到媒体对这个问题的报道程度很高，这是令人惊讶的。surprising：令人惊讶的
considering：考虑到……
high level of：高水平的，大量的
media coverage：媒体报道
issue：问题		“considering” 是介词或连词，意为“考虑到”，引导原因状语；“media coverage” 不可数，指媒体覆盖。
Some children expressed the idea that the conservation of rainforests is not important.一些孩子表达了保护雨林并不重要的观点。expressed：表达
the idea that...：……的观点
conservation：保护
not important：不重要		“expressed the idea that...” 后接同位语从句，解释 idea 的内容；注意 conservation 不可数。
The results of this study suggest that certain ideas predominate in the thinking of children about rainforests.这项研究的结果表明，某些观念在孩子们关于雨林的想法中占主导地位。results：结果
suggest：表明
certain：某些
predominate：占优势，占主导地位
thinking：思维，想法		“suggest” 此处不是“建议”，而是“表明”，后接宾语从句无需用虚拟语气。“predominate in” 意为“在……中占主导”。
Pupils' responses indicate some misconceptions in basic scientific knowledge of rainforests' ecosystems such as their ideas about rainforests as habitats for animals, plants and humans and the relationship between climatic change and destruction of rainforests.学生的回答表明，他们在雨林生态系统的基本科学知识上存在一些误解，比如他们认为雨林是动物、植物和人类的栖息地，以及气候变化与雨林破坏之间的关系等看法。responses：回答
indicate：表明
misconceptions：误解
scientific knowledge：科学知识
ecosystems：生态系统
habitats：栖息地
climatic change：气候变化
destruction：破坏		“such as” 列举例子；句子较长，注意 “their ideas about... and the relationship...” 并列。“indicate” 后接宾语从句。
Pupils did not volunteer ideas that suggested that they appreciated the complexity of causes of rainforest destruction.学生们没有主动提出能表明他们认识到雨林破坏原因复杂性的观点。volunteer：自愿提供，主动说出
suggested：表明
appreciated：理解，认识到
complexity：复杂性
causes：原因
destruction：破坏		“volunteer” 用作动词，表示主动提供信息；“that suggested that...” 定语从句修饰 ideas，第二个 that 引导宾语从句；“appreciate” 在此意为“理解，意识到”，而非“欣赏”。
In other words, they gave no indication of an appreciation of either the range of ways in which rainforests are important or the complex social, economic and political factors which drive the activities which are destroying the rainforests.换句话说，他们丝毫没有表现出对雨林重要性的诸多方面，或驱动破坏雨林活动的复杂社会、经济和政治因素有所认识。in other words：换句话说
gave no indication of：没有表现出……的迹象
appreciation：理解，认识
range of：一系列
complex：复杂的
social, economic and political factors：社会、经济和政治因素
drive：驱动
activities：活动
destroying：破坏		“gave no indication of an appreciation of...” 双重名词结构，表示未表现出理解；“either...or...” 连接两个并列的 of 宾语；“range of ways in which...” 定语从句；“factors which drive the activities which are destroying...” 多重定语从句。
One encouragement is that the results of similar studies about other environmental issues suggest that older children seem to acquire the ability to appreciate, value and evaluate conflicting views.一个令人鼓舞的事实是，针对其他环境议题的类似研究结果表明，年龄较大的孩子似乎能够获得理解、重视和评估相互矛盾观点的能力。encouragement：令人鼓舞的事
similar studies：类似研究
environmental issues：环境问题
acquire：获得
ability：能力
appreciate：理解，赏析
value：重视
evaluate：评估
conflicting views：相互矛盾的观点		“One encouragement is that...” 表语从句；“suggest” 表明；“seem to acquire” 似乎获得；“the ability to do...” 不定式作定语；列举三个动词。
Environmental education offers an arena in which these skills can be developed, which is essential for these children as future decision-makers.环境教育提供了一个舞台，这些技能可以在其中得到发展，这对作为未来决策者的孩子们至关重要。environmental education：环境教育
offers：提供
arena：舞台，领域
skills：技能
developed：发展
essential：至关重要的
decision-makers：决策者		“offers an arena in which...” 定语从句；“which is essential...” 非限制性定语从句修饰整个主句或前文；“as future decision-makers” 作为未来决策者。
Some of the senses that we and other terrestrial mammals take for granted are either reduced or absent in cetaceans or fail to function well in water.我们和其他陆地哺乳动物视为理所当然的一些感官，在鲸目动物身上要么减弱或缺失，要么在水中无法正常工作。senses：感官
terrestrial mammals：陆地哺乳动物
take for granted：认为……理所当然
reduced：减弱
absent：缺失
cetaceans：鲸目动物
fail to function：无法工作		“take for granted” 固定搭配，认为……理所当然；“either reduced or absent... or fail...” 并列结构；“fail to function” 无法正常运作。
For example, it appears from their brain structure that toothed species are unable to smell.例如，从它们的大脑结构来看，齿鲸似乎没有嗅觉。appears：似乎
brain structure：大脑结构
toothed species：齿鲸类（有牙齿的物种）
unable to：不能
smell：嗅觉，闻		“it appears that...” 句型，意为“似乎……”；“from their brain structure” 根据大脑结构；“toothed species” 指有齿的鲸类。
Baleen species, on the other hand, appear to have some related brain structures but it is not known whether these are functional.另一方面，须鲸似乎有一些相关的大脑结构，但尚不清楚这些结构是否起作用。baleen species：须鲸类
on the other hand：另一方面
related：相关的
brain structures：大脑结构
functional：起作用的，功能性的		“on the other hand” 表示对比转折；“appear to have” 似乎有；“it is not known whether...” 主语从句，it 为形式主语。
It has been speculated that, as the blowholes evolved and migrated to the top of the head, the neural pathways serving sense of smell may have been nearly all sacrificed.据推测，随着喷气孔进化并迁移到头顶，负责嗅觉的神经通路可能几乎全部牺牲了。speculated：推测
blowholes：喷气孔
evolved：进化
migrated：迁移
neural pathways：神经通路
serving：服务于，负责
sense of smell：嗅觉
sacrificed：牺牲，丧失		“It has been speculated that...” 人们推测……；“as” 随着，引导时间状语从句；“serving sense of smell” 现在分词短语作定语；“may have been sacrificed” 可能已经被牺牲。
Similarly, although at least some cetaceans have taste buds, the nerves serving these have degenerated or are rudimentary.类似地，尽管至少有些鲸目动物有味蕾，但负责味蕾的神经已经退化或处于未发育状态。similarly：类似地
at least：至少
taste buds：味蕾
nerves：神经
serving：负责
degenerated：退化
rudimentary：未发育的，基本的		“although” 引导让步状语从句；“serving these” 修饰 nerves；“have degenerated or are rudimentary” 并列谓语。

item.title: Unit 53-55
item.description: 【非谓语动词 60%】动词+ing（enjoy/stop）；动词+to do（decide/forget）；动词+宾语+to do（want/advise）

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 1 - 2026-08-06 02:38
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：38 分钟 (1899 字符)

原文翻译参考词汇表达讲解
The second question concerned the geographical location of rainforests. 第二个问题涉及热带雨林的地理位置。 geographical: 地理的
rainforest: 热带雨林
concerned: 涉及，与…有关		 concerned 在此为及物动词，意为“涉及”；geographical location 是名词短语作宾语。
The commonest responses were continents or countries: Africa (given by 43% of children), South America (30%), Brazil (25%). 最常见的回答是大陆或国家：非洲（43%的儿童提及）、南美洲（30%）、巴西（25%）。 commonest: 最常见的 (common的最高级)
continents: 大陆
responses: 回答		 commonest 是 common 的最高级形式；括号中的 given by... 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰前面的 Africa 等。
Some children also gave more general locations, such as being near the Equator. 一些孩子还给出了更笼统的位置，例如在赤道附近。 Equator: 赤道
general: 大致的，笼统的
being near: 位于…附近		 such as being near the Equator 中，such as 后接动名词短语表示举例；being near 相当于“在…附近”。
Responses to question three concerned the importance of rainforests. 对问题三的回答涉及热带雨林的重要性。 responses: 回答
importance: 重要性		 Responses to... 表示“针对…的回答”，concerned 再次作“涉及”解。
The dominant idea, raised by 64% of the pupils, was that rainforests provide animals with habitats. 由64%的小学生提出的主要观点是，热带雨林为动物提供了栖息地。 dominant: 主导的，主要的
raised: 提出
pupils: 学生
habitats: 栖息地
provide...with...: 为…提供…		 raised by... 是过去分词短语作定语；that 引导表语从句；固定搭配 provide sb. with sth.。
Fewer students responded that rainforests provide plant habitats, and even fewer (60%) raised the idea of rainforest as animal habitats. 较少的学生回答雨林提供植物栖息地，而更少（的学生）（60%）提出了雨林作为动物栖息地的观点。 fewer: 更少的
responded: 回答
raised the idea: 提出观点		 Fewer students... 是比较级；括号中的百分比对更少的学生作补充说明。
Similarly, but at a lower level, more girls (13%) than boys (5%) said that rainforests provided human habitats. 类似地，但比例更低，更多的女孩（13%）比男孩（5%）说雨林提供了人类栖息地。 similarly: 类似地
at a lower level: 在较低层次/比例上
provided: 提供		 Similarly, but at a lower level 作状语；more... than... 比较结构；said 后接宾语从句。
These observations are generally consistent with our previous studies of pupils' views about the use and conservation of rainforests, in which girls were shown to be more sympathetic to animals and expressed views which seem to place an intrinsic value on non-human animal life. 这些观察结果总体上与我们之前关于学生对雨林利用和保护看法的研究一致，在那些研究中，女孩被证明对动物更有同情心，并表达了似乎赋予非人类动物生命内在价值的观点。 observations: 观察(结果)
consistent with: 与…一致
previous: 之前的
conservation: 保护
sympathetic: 有同情心的
intrinsic: 内在的，固有的
place a value on: 赋予…价值
non-human: 非人类的		 are consistent with 为固定搭配；in which 引导非限制性定语从句，指代 studies；were shown to be 是被动语态；place an intrinsic value on... 是固定表达。
The fourth question concerned the causes of the destruction of rainforests. 第四个问题涉及雨林破坏的原因。 causes: 原因
destruction: 破坏		 the causes of the destruction of rainforests 是由 of 构成的所属结构。
Perhaps encouragingly, more than half of the pupils (59%) identified that it is human activities which are destroying rainforests, some personalizing the responsibility by the use of terms such as 'we are'. 也许令人鼓舞的是，超过一半的学生（59%）认识到是人类活动正在破坏热带雨林，一些人通过使用“我们是”这样的措辞将责任个人化。 encouragingly: 令人鼓舞地
identified: 识别出，发现
personalizing: 使个人化
responsibility: 责任
terms: 措辞		 Perhaps encouragingly 是句子副词；it is... which... 为强调句型；some personalizing... 是独立主格结构，作伴随状语。
About 18% of the pupils referred specifically to logging activity. 大约18%的学生特别提到了伐木活动。 referred to: 提到
specifically: 特别地，具体地
logging: 伐木		 referred to 是固定短语，注意 refer 的过去式 referred 要双写 r。
One misconception, expressed by some 1% of the pupils, was that acid rain is responsible for rainforest destruction. 一个误解，由大约1%的学生表达，是酸雨导致了雨林破坏。 misconception: 误解，错误观念
expressed: 表达
acid rain: 酸雨
responsible for: 对…负责，是…的原因		 expressed by... 是过去分词短语作定语；that 引导表语从句；is responsible for 表示“是…的原因”。
A similar proportion said that pollution is destroying rainforests. 类似比例（的学生）说污染正在破坏雨林。 proportion: 比例
pollution: 污染		 A similar proportion 作主语，指前文提到的百分比的学生。
Here, children are confusing rainforest destruction with damage to the forests of Western Europe by these factors. 这里，孩子们将雨林破坏与这些因素对西欧森林造成的破坏混淆了。 confusing: 混淆
damage: 损害, 破坏
Western Europe: 西欧
factors: 因素		 are confusing A with B 是 confuse... with... 的进行时，意为“把A与B混淆”；damage to the forests 是名词短语。
While two fifths of the students provided the information that the rainforests provide oxygen, in some cases this response also embraced the misconception that rainforest destruction would reduce atmospheric oxygen, making the atmosphere incompatible with human life on Earth. 虽然五分之二的学生提供了雨林提供氧气这一信息，但在某些情况下，这种回答也包含了误解，即雨林破坏会减少大气中的氧气，使大气变得不适合人类在地球上生存。 two fifths: 五分之二
embraced: 包含，接纳
reduce: 减少
atmospheric: 大气的
incompatible: 不相容的，不适合的		 While 引导让步状语从句；that the rainforests provide oxygen 为同位语从句；embraced the misconception that... 中 that 引导同位语从句；making the atmosphere... 是现在分词短语作结果状语，其中 incompatible with 是固定搭配。

item.title: [英语] IELTS4 Reading Passage 1 - 2026-08-04 08:20
item.description:
⏱ 预计阅读时间：41 分钟 (2050 字符)

原文 翻译参考 词汇 表达讲解
Adults and children are frequently confronted with statements about the alarming rate of loss of tropical rainforests. 成人和儿童经常面对关于热带雨林以惊人速度消失的言论。 confronted with：面对
alarming：令人惊恐的
rate：速度，比率
tropical rainforests：热带雨林		 被动语态 "are confronted with" 表示“被面对”，固定搭配。
For example, one graphic illustration to which children might readily relate is the estimate that rainforests are being destroyed at a rate equivalent to one thousand football fields every forty minutes - about the duration of a normal classroom period. 例如，一个孩子们容易联想到的生动例子是：据估计，热带雨林正以每四十分钟消失一千个足球场的速度被摧毁——这大约是一节正常课时的时间。 graphic illustration：生动的例证
readily relate：容易产生共鸣
equivalent to：等同于
duration：持续时间		 定语从句 "to which children might readily relate" 修饰 illustration，"relate to" 在此意为“理解或产生共鸣”。破折号后补充说明速度的频率。
In the face of the frequent and often vivid media coverage, it is likely that children will have formed ideas about rainforests - what and where they are, why they are important, what endangers them - independent of any formal tuition. 面对频繁且通常生动的媒体报道，孩子们很可能已经形成了关于雨林的看法——它们是什么、在哪里、为何重要、什么威胁它们——这些看法与任何正规教育无关。 vivid：生动的
coverage：报道，覆盖
formed ideas：形成看法
endangers：危及
independent of：独立于
formal tuition：正规教学		 "In the face of" 固定短语，意为“面对”。"it is likely that..." 句型。破折号内补充说明 ideas 的内容。"independent of" 作状语。
It is also possible that some of these ideas will be mistaken. 也有可能其中一些看法是错误的。 mistaken：错误的 "It is also possible that..." 句型，表推测。
Many studies have shown that children harbor misconceptions about 'pure', curriculum science. 许多研究表明，孩子们对“纯”课程科学持有误解。 harbor：怀有（想法）
misconceptions：误解
curriculum：课程		 "harbor misconceptions" 搭配，表示“持有错误观念”。引号内的 'pure' 指纯科学。
These misconceptions do not remain isolated but become incorporated into a multifaceted, but organized, conceptual framework, making it and the component ideas, some of which are erroneous, more robust but also accessible to modification. 这些误解并不是孤立的，而是被整合进一个多层面但组织有序的概念框架中，使得这个框架及其组成部分（其中一些是错误的）更加稳固，但也易于修改。 incorporated into：融入
multifaceted：多方面的
conceptual framework：概念框架
component：组成部分
erroneous：错误的
robust：稳固的
accessible to modification：可修改的		 并列结构 "do not remain... but become..."。"making it ... more robust but also accessible..." 现在分词作结果状语，"it" 指代框架。"some of which are erroneous" 为非限制性定语从句。
These ideas may be developed by children absorbing ideas through the popular media. 这些观念可能是孩子们通过大众媒体吸收想法而形成的。 absorbing：吸收
popular media：大众媒体		 被动语态 "may be developed by..."。"children absorbing ideas" 为动名词复合结构，作 by 的宾语。
Sometimes this information may be erroneous. 有时这类信息可能是错误的。 erroneous：错误的 情态动词 may 表推测。
It seems schools may not be providing an opportunity for children to re-express their ideas and so have them tested and refined by teachers and their peers. 似乎学校可能没有提供机会让孩子们重新表达他们的想法，从而让老师和同学来检验和完善这些想法。 re-express：重新表达
refined：完善，提炼
peers：同龄人		 "It seems (that)..." 句型。"have them tested and refined" 为 have sth done 结构，意为“使...被检验/完善”。
Despite the extensive coverage in the popular media of the destruction of rainforests, little formal information is available about children's ideas in this area. 尽管大众媒体对雨林破坏有广泛的报道，但关于儿童在这一领域的想法，却几乎没有正式的信息。 extensive：广泛的
coverage：报道
destruction：破坏
available：可获得的		 Despite 引导让步状语，主句中 "little" 表示否定，意为“几乎没有”。
The aim of the present study is to start to provide such information, to help teachers design their educational strategies to build upon correct ideas and to displace misconceptions and to plan programs in environmental studies in their schools. 本研究的目的是开始提供这类信息，帮助教师设计教育策略以建立在正确观念上并取代误解，并在学校规划环境研究项目。 aim：目的
present：当前的
strategies：策略
build upon：在...基础上发展
displace：取代
misconceptions：误解
environmental studies：环境研究		 表语由三个并列不定式短语构成："to start...", "to help...", "to plan..."。其中 "build upon correct ideas" 和 "displace misconceptions" 为具体策略。
The study surveys children's scientific knowledge and attitudes to rainforests. 该研究调查了儿童的科学知识和对热带雨林的态度。 surveys：调查
attitudes：态度		 简单句，调查...知识和态度。
Secondary school children were asked to complete a questionnaire containing five open-form questions. 中学生被要求完成一份包含五个开放式问题的问卷。 Secondary school：中学
questionnaire：问卷
open-form questions：开放式问题		 被动语态，"containing" 现在分词作定语修饰 questionnaire。
The most frequent responses to the first question were descriptions which are self-evident from the term 'rainforest'. 对第一个问题最常见的回答是那些从“雨林”这个词本身就显而易见的描述。 frequent responses：常见的回答
self-evident：不言而喻的		 "self-evident from..." 表示“从...来看不言而喻”。定语从句 which are self-evident... 修饰 descriptions。
Some children described them as damp, wet or hot. 一些孩子把它们描述为潮湿、湿润或炎热的。 damp：潮湿的
wet：湿润的		 "described them as..." 意为“将它们描述为...”，as 后接形容词。
